name: RepoStory
tagline: Turns any public GitHub repository's history into a readable timeline of milestones and technologies.
problem: Learning how someone built a project means wading through files and commits.
solution: Agents split commit history into milestones and explain what was built, how and with what, using fast inference.
demo_moment: Team-described: paste a repo URL and read its build story milestone by milestone.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Cerebras: Best Use of Cerebras” among 261 submissions.
Uses fast inference to process whole histories quickly.

lessons: Fast-inference prizes suit jobs that read a lot of text at once.
